description: This file provides functions to validate and manipulate boot configuration files, specifically handling magic bytes, partition indexing, and setting or toggling the primary boot partition within the file.

methods.name: validate_bootconfig_magic
methods.description: Validates the magic bytes at the start and end of the boot configuration file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_numparts
methods.description: Retrieves the number of partitions defined in the boot configuration file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_partidx
methods.description: Finds the index of a specified partition name within the configuration file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Retrieves the primary boot flag for a specified partition.

methods.name: set_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Sets the primary boot flag for a specified partition.

methods.name: toggle_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Toggles the primary boot flag for a specified partition.
